summary: JOYY Inc. filed a Form 6-K with its unaudited financial results for Q1 2026, reporting net revenues of $555.7M, up 12.4% year-over-year. Operating income was $6.8M, and non-GAAP EBITDA was $45.7M. Net income from continuing operations attributable to controlling interest was $50.7M. The press release covers routine financial and business highlights, including user metrics and revenue breakdowns. No special-situation corporate action (merger, tender, activist campaign, restructuring, etc.) is disclosed; this is a standard quarterly earnings release. There are no deal terms, as no transaction is proposed or announced.
